systems.system: Ghana Card registration of children aged 6 to 14
systems.owner: National Identification Authority (NIA), with the National Health Insurance Authority
systems.tiers: phased, starting in the Volta and Oti Regions on 5 May 2026, each phase at least 21 days; cards from the 2024 pilot collected at NIA district offices

note: Announcement of an identity-card enrolment campaign for children; the birth certificate appears only as a supporting document.
